components.text: Operating hours

Weekdays/Saturdays: Most sources show service starting around 5:00 AM and ending around 11:05 PM on the Purple and Green lines; the Yellow Line runs later in the evening from RV Road, up to 11:55 PM from that station.
Sundays: Trains generally start at 7:00 AM.
Ticket and pass options
Single-journey tokens are available for one trip.
Smart cards are available for repeated travel and usually give a fare discount versus tokens.
QR-code / digital tickets are also accepted.
Tourist passes listed in current fare guides include 1-day, 3-day, and 5-day options.
Interchange stations
The main interchange is Nadaprabhu Kempegowda Station, Majestic, where the Purple Line and Green Line meet.
RV Road is the key interchange between the Green Line and Yellow Line.
Other important interchange points include Jayadeva Hospital, Central Silk Board, Krishnarajapura, MG Road, Mysuru Road, J.P. Nagar, and Jaya Prakash Nagara.
First-time rider quick guide
Buy a token for one trip or a smart card if you will make multiple rides.
Check your route for the correct interchange station before boarding.
Expect the network to be busiest during weekday morning and evening peak hours.
If you are changing lines, Majestic and RV Road are the simplest transfer points to remember.
